observed.scope: full arms A3/P3: independent solver rebuilt <=4/<=5 supports for both actions, saturation, the Y1k union for both actions, LU-R lookahead copies (A3) and window rows; every score and action, every decision incl. RESYNC_AMBIGUOUS downgrades, public certificates, wrong flags, surprise/residual/alarm, post-contradiction probabilities and forecast_source, issued lists and retraction reasons recomputed; P3 checked against the frozen v0.1.1 control at every step. Slim arms (A2, P2, E2 and the extended block): scores, actions, check flags, both decisions, wrong flags, issued/retraction lists, stale and switch metrics recomputed; their alarm flag is read from the trace (no probabilities stored).

observed.decision_rule: CONFIRMED iff M and P1 hold and S(A2) >= 5 and S(E2) <= 0.5 x S(A2). FALSIFIED iff M holds, S(A2) >= 5 and S(E2) >= S(A2) (restoring checks does not reduce stale certainty, so stale certainty is not caused by the suppression of checks). Otherwise OPEN (including M failing or S(A2) < 5).
